# Encinitas Appraiser
> Encinitas and San Diego County residential appraisals by Brian Ward, California Certified Residential Real Estate Appraiser (since 2004, 7,000+ appraisals). Market site of Brian Ward Appraisal (https://www.brianward.com/). Private-party work only; no lending appraisals.

- Phone: (760) 300-3722
- Email: contact@encinitas.pro
- Office: 15877 Paseo Del Sur, San Diego, CA 92127
- Fees: Basic Desktop $299, Desktop $449, Desktop 2-4 Unit $549 (anywhere in California); Drive-By $649, Standard $699, Standard 2-4 Unit $799 (only in Brian's 68 in-person communities: 33 San Diego County including Encinitas, 35 Riverside County).
- Purposes: date of death, estate and trust, divorce, bankruptcy, Prop 19 and property tax, family transfer, pre-purchase, pre-listing, insurance claim, bail bond, expert witness, USCIS Form I-864 home equity.
- Order: https://www.encinitas.pro/contact/ (asks whether a specific effective date is needed)
